claims.evidence: Photo 0 dashboard background text reads 'Xbox One', confirming the console is an Xbox One, not a Series X

claims.claim: 6 games installed (FC26, Far Cry 3, Modern Warfare 3, Dishonored 2, Tomb Raider, unnamed 6th)
claims.evidence: Only FC26 is visible on screen (splash/gameplay); the installed games list or dashboard library view is not shown

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo of internal casing screws, warranty seal, or disassembly marks
No thermal/performance test clip or extended run footage shown
No close-up of HDMI, USB, power, or A/V ports with cables inserted and functioning
Only a single wireless controller is visible across all three photos
No photo of the receipt provided

risks.risk: Console generation misrepresented (Series X claimed, Xbox One confirmed) — affects base value significantly
risks.proof: Clear photo of the console's front/top casing and rear port layout, which differ visibly between Xbox One and Series X
risks.if_unproven: priced as Xbox One, the model confirmed by the witness

risks.risk: Storage capacity unknown (500GB vs 1TB), affects value
risks.proof: Settings/console info screen photo showing storage capacity

risks.risk: Games installed may be digital licenses tied to seller's account, not transferable
risks.proof: Screenshot of 'Manage Game & Add-ons' or account/profile screen showing ownership type
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, games not counted as included value

risks.risk: Only one controller actually present despite 'pads' (plural) claim
risks.proof: Photo showing two or more controllers together
risks.if_unproven: priced with a single controller only

risks.risk: Disc drive and internal condition (dust, wear, overheating history) unverifiable from photos
risks.proof: Video of console running a disc-based game or boot-up with visible fan/vent close-up
risks.if_unproven: priced as average cosmetic/functional condition, no premium for 'like new'

risks.proof: Video showing each port in use with a cable/peripheral
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming standard wear, not 'all ports confirmed working'

risks.risk: Proof of purchase (UK receipt) unverifiable, affects warranty/authenticity confidence
risks.proof: Clear photo of the receipt with date, retailer, and serial number matching the console

proof_requests: Photo of the rear port panel and side profile to confirm Xbox One vs Series X body shape
Console settings/system info screen showing storage capacity and serial number
Photo of all controllers included, laid out together
Video of console running a disc or showing 'Manage Game & Add-ons' to confirm game ownership type
Close-up video/photo of ports in active use
Clear photo of the UK receipt
response.reason: The witness confirms this is an Xbox One (not the Series X the seller claims), so it is priced at Xbox One worst-case with only one verified controller and no confirmed extras; the model and controller-count discrepancies are flagged as risks rather than treated as fraud, since they may stem from seller confusion over naming.
